svg.text: 剑影 JIÀNYǏNG · EVERY ITEM, AND THE STAT TABLE REDONE — PROPOSAL
All 22 items that exist today, regrouped into 5 sets. No item invented, no wardrobe style added. The stat lines and the ranks are the proposal.
Each slot is tempered in its own language
A hole in my own earlier proposal, found by drawing the items separately instead of only the robe. Hems and belt cords are ROBE marks — a hat cannot
grow a hem. Now you can tell WHICH piece was tempered, not merely that something was.
Ten stat kinds become four, and every one has a scale
Ten kinds across sixteen armour pieces was not a system, it was sixteen exceptions — and it produced dead rows: +10 max health beside +28 is an
obsolete item, not a choice. Four kinds, each rising with rank, means no piece is ever strictly worse than one you own. It is lower ranked, and that
a fully tempered piece is worth 150% more
a fully tempered piece is worth 150% more
a fully tempered piece is worth 150% more
a fully tempered piece is worth 150% more
All twenty-two, one at a time
Each figure differs from the default swordsman in exactly one slot, so what you are looking at is that piece and nothing else. Left is found, right is
fully tempered. The set decides which stat the line carries; the slot decides the shape.
The town that has forged for a thousand years. Nothing it makes is wrong.
Forged the night its maker walked into his own furnace to make the metal run.
Ganjiang's pair, and its opposite. Water where he was fire.
It leaves an unjust king in the night, and is found next morning in another hand.
Short enough to be carried inside a served fish. Drawn once, at the table.
What a swordsman is handed on the first day. It belongs to nobody.
The table is still only 22 items, which is a handful of expeditions before you own all of them. Ranks buy depth without new items — a set you own
at 阶 0 is not the same as one at 阶 5 — but that is a stopgap, not an answer. Set-family silhouettes are what makes more items cheap later.
Also open: the two sets sharing 锋 Edge. Five sets and four stats do not divide, and pretending otherwise would be a worse answer than saying so.
